text: Who has been backing Silver Blaze, so that his price has shortened?
why: The story has already shown the price shortening from fifteen to one to under three to one (¶188), and Holmes remarks that somebody knows something (¶189). The question is plain and the reader has reason to ask it.

text: Who has been backing Silver Blaze, so that his price has shortened? — someone else who has heard that the horse is found
id: q.odds_who=someone else who has heard that the horse is found
why: The story never says the horse has been found or that anyone has heard so. Colonel Ross says he has seen nothing of his horse (¶184), and the only route to the horse is Holmes's private deduction, which no character has shared. Nobody in the story gives a reader reason to consider this possibility.
